notes.title: Major Update: Custom Car Support, New Cars & Enhanced Menu!
notes.content:
Just Drive v0.4.0 is here

This major update brings exciting new features to the game!

Here's what's new and improved:

[list]
[*] Players can now import their own custom cars into the game by preparing models in 3D software like Blender, creating a Godot 4.3 project, and exporting them to the game via PCK files.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840758/3a9b8a99deeb8fb302bb8d9f4d12f3312a78c754.png[/img]

[*]  In addition, 13 new street cars have been added, expanding your driving options.
[*] We’ve also introduced new car classifications with 'era' and 'class' categories to better organize vehicles.
[*] The main menu and UI has been revamped.
[*] You can now see detailed car weight and engine power in the car selection menu.
[/list]

notes.title: New Drift Mode, Split Screen, and More!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone,[/h3]

[h3]We're thrilled to announce a major update packed with exciting new features as Drift Mode and Split Screen.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840758/f29cc1ae2282f18661c61a86f3744f767ffaa29c.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840758/115ef939652fc6c0b2f7664a559f9a8c97b824d4.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]Here's what's is this version:[/b][/h3]

[h3]New Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Split Screen Mode:[/b] Enjoy racing with friends in the new split screen mode
[*] [b]Drift Mode:[/b] Experience the thrill of drifting with our brand-new Drift mode.
[*] [b]New Drift Track[/b]: To master the art of drifting.
[*] [b]Drift Camera[/b]: Get the perfect angle with the new Drift camera.
[*] [b]Hood Camera[/b]: Immerse yourself in the action with the new Hood camera.
[*] [b]New Street Cars[/b]: Rear-wheel drive models designed for perfect drifting.
[*] [b]Persistent Camera[/b]: Your preferred camera mode is now saved - for both P1 and P2.
[*] [b]Back to Menu Button[/b]: Easily navigate back to the menu from the level info panel.
[/list]
[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Leaderboard entries for the current player are now displayed in a different color for better visibility.
[/list]
[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tachometer: The tachometer now correctly shows the speed.
[/list]
[h3]Note:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Score Attack and Fly Attack levels are currently disabled as we work on adjustments to enhance your experience on these levels.
[/list]

We're committed to continuously improving your gaming experience. Dive into the new Drift mode, take the new cars for a spin, challenge your friends in split screen mode, and enjoy the latest enhancements and fixes.

Happy racing!

notes.title: Just Drive v0.2.0 is now available
notes.content:
[h2]Just Drive v0.2.0 Update is Here! Experience Enhanced Driving Fun![/h2]

[b]We’ve just released Just Drive v0.2.0 with a fresh and fun driving experience.[/b]

[h3]What's New in This Version:[/h3]

[list]
[*] [b]Revamped Vehicle Physics:[/b] Enjoy a superior racing experience with our all-new vehicle physics system. Now, you can maintain control at high speeds and experience different grip levels on asphalt, grass, dirt, and sand.

[*] [b]User-Friendly Input Display:[/b] Input key names are now displayed with easy-to-read, friendly names for better clarity.

[*] [b]Improved Leaderboard UI:[/b] We've added background colors to leaderboard entries for improved readability.

[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] Resolved an issue where the game appeared frozen when resetting the car and pausing during a screen fade.

[*] [b]New Time Attack Track:[/b] Challenge yourself with an exciting new track in Time Attack mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44840758/89298ed6a3a624702e9018b11d40ee2aa979be9e.png[/img]
[/list]
